reports.name: Q.Sb.bisa-1A
reports.note: 139 advanced CIMMYT spring wheat lines, GBS SNPs called on RefSeq v1.0, FarmCPU GWAS; Env1 Pusa 2019, Env2 Pusa 2020 (India), Env3 BARI Jamalpur 2017 (Bangladesh), natural infection; P < 0.003 in Table 2. The paper gives allele effects on disease severity (marker effect and "Effect 10X"), not PVE. Significant in Env1, Env2; peak SNP S1A_497201550; MAF 0.28. Allele effect: C allele +1.88 (Effect 10X 18.83) in Env1, +1.83 in Env2. Both SNPs lie 9.4 kb from TraesCS1A01G303600 (LURP-one-like protein); TraesCS1A01G303700 (GTP cyclohydrolase 1) 23 kb away. Reported as a new QTL. Earlier record lacked markers and effects. Re-read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad61.py).

reports.name: Q.Sb.bisa-2B
reports.note: 139 advanced CIMMYT spring wheat lines, GBS SNPs called on RefSeq v1.0, FarmCPU GWAS; Env1 Pusa 2019, Env2 Pusa 2020 (India), Env3 BARI Jamalpur 2017 (Bangladesh), natural infection; P < 0.003 in Table 2. The paper gives allele effects on disease severity (marker effect and "Effect 10X"), not PVE. Significant in Env1, Env2, Env3; peak SNP S2B_422983662; MAF 0.11 (S2B_422983662); 0.45-0.46 (Env3 SNPs). Allele effect: A allele of S2B_422983662 +3.01 (Effect 10X 30.07) in Env1, +3.07 (30.68) in Env2, the largest effect in the study; ten Env3 SNPs about 2.3. Genes in the interval include a MADS-box transcription factor region, isocitrate lyase (TraesCS2B01G300200) and an auxin response factor (TraesCS2B01G300300). Detected in all three environments; reported as a new QTL. The abstract gives 421.92 Mb. Earlier record lacked markers and effects. Re-read from the paper, Nov 2026 (ad61.py).
